sun.meaning: Your edges are porous: you absorb moods, read subtext, and imagine your way into other lives without trying. Boundaries are not a betrayal of that gift. They are its maintenance.

planets.signLine: In Pisces, it takes on a mutable water style. Porous, imaginative, tuned to what goes unspoken.

aspects.line: Your Mercury is fused to your Uranus. Your way of thinking and your independence run as one instrument, hard to play separately.
Your Sun is fused to your Mercury. The self and its narrator share a desk, which makes the account vivid and the distance between you and your own opinions small.
Your Mars has an open line to your Saturn. Your drive and your sense of duty cooperate whenever you remember to ask.
Your Sun is fused to your Uranus. Your sense of self and your independence run as one instrument, hard to play separately.
Your Saturn grinds against your Pluto. Your sense of duty and your intensity pull in directions ninety degrees apart: permanent friction, and the strength that comes from working against it.
Your Mars runs downhill into your Uranus. Your drive and your independence help each other so smoothly the gift is easy to miss.
Your Venus grinds against your Pluto. Your way of caring and your intensity pull in directions ninety degrees apart: permanent friction, and the strength that comes from working against it.
